memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me. Then I came down from the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the Lord commanded me, and they are there now. - Deut 10:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Once God had written His commandments again, the tablets were placed in the ark — the sacred chest at the heart of Israel's worship. There they would be kept, protected, and treasured. "They are there now," Moses says. God's word was not left to be scattered or lost; it was carefully preserved at the very center of the nation's life with God. The commandments were not a passing message but an enduring treasure to be guarded across the generations.

This reflects something wonderful about God's word: it endures. Human words come and go, forgotten with time, but God's word is preserved and lasting. The tablets in the ark were a physical reminder that God's truth does not expire or fade. What He has spoken stands. Down through the centuries, in every kind of hardship and opposition, God has faithfully preserved His word so that it could reach us today.

Jesus said, "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away" (Matt 24:35). The Bible you hold has been carried faithfully across thousands of years by the God who preserves His word. That is a gift beyond measure. We do not build our lives on shifting human opinions but on the enduring, preserved word of God. Treasure it as Israel treasured those tablets. Keep it at the center of your life, not at the edges. God's word is a lasting treasure, and it will not fail you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I treat God's word as a passing message or an enduring treasure?
- Is Scripture at the center of my life, or at the edges?
- How does the truth that God's word endures forever encourage me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your word endures forever and has been faithfully preserved so it could reach me. Help me to treasure it, to keep it at the center of my life, and to build all I am on Your unchanging, lasting truth. Amen.
